reason: Agent converged to a hovering strategy (971 steps avg) exploiting low step penalty (-0.2) and timeout loophole where termination failure penalty is not triggered on max-steps truncation. Increasing step penalty to -0.5 makes time expensive, forcing faster landing attempts. Relaxing velocity threshold to 0.6 makes success bonus more reachable.
preserved_design: State-based success detection (Leg Contact + Low Velocity + Near Pad).
Fuel penalty mechanism (weight 0.5) to discourage wasteful thrusting.
changed_design: Increased step_penalty from -0.2 to -0.5 per step to penalize hovering/timeout significantly.
Relaxed landing_success velocity threshold from 0.5 to 0.6 to increase success signal density.
Maintained failure penalty logic but relied on higher cumulative time cost to discourage non-terminating timeouts.
risk: Agent may rush and crash more frequently initially due to high time pressure.
Higher step penalty might dominate fuel efficiency if not balanced by success bonus discovery.
Velocity threshold relaxation might allow slightly harder landings but reduces risk of missing the bonus entirely.

expected_metric_changes.mean_fuel_cost_per_episode: May decrease as episodes end sooner, or increase slightly if descent requires more thrust initially.
expected_metric_changes.fitness_score: Initial drop possible due to higher step penalties, followed by recovery as landing is discovered.
